title: A Boat on the Lake
story:
Elena and her cousin Pedro wanted a calm afternoon on the lake. They rented a small wooden boat from Nia at the dock. Nia gave them two oars and a bright orange life jacket each. She warned them to stay near the shore if the wind rose. The water was smooth, and the boat moved with a steady rhythm. Pedro rowed first, while Elena watched a line of ducks.

After a while, they reached a tiny island with three pine trees. They pulled the boat onto the sand and walked around the trees. Elena found a smooth stone and put it in her pocket. Pedro noticed dark clouds gathering over the far hills. The wind began to push small waves against the shore. They remembered Nia's warning and hurried back to the boat. Elena rowed, and Pedro kept his eyes on the dock. The waves made the boat rock, but the jackets kept them safe. A fish jumped beside them, and they both laughed.

Slowly, the orange roof of the boathouse came into sight. Nia was waiting with a thick rope in her hands. She tied the boat and checked that they were dry. Elena showed her the stone and described the little island. Nia smiled and said the lake could change very quickly. Pedro thanked her and promised to watch the clouds next time. They walked home with tired arms and a story for the family.
